sentences.text: This is first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.153/2023 dated 01.07.2023 registered at Police Station Kundam, District Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 08.09.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

The applicant is a permanent resident of district and is Jagdish Saiyam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194726423/
1 ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
In this case, the age of prosecutrix was almost 17 years at the time of incident.
She left the house and stayed with the applicant for almost three months in Indore.

6. Having considered the statements of prosecutrix and also the facts available in the case diary, I find it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

NP (ANURADHA SHUKLA)
 JUDGE Jagdish Saiyam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194726423/
